name: Ship gate client config (powos self push --ship)
purpose: the secret and url `powos self push --ship` uses to ask the Mac ship gate (unit ship-gate-mac) to ship a pushed sha; the Mac's own secret file, copied by rooted.sh deploy as a file (never on a command line or in a log), only when missing or different; url defaults to the Mac's LAN address 192.168.50.99:7433
